evals.prompt: I have a hedera-harness clone open. Help me author a Tier 0-1 benchmark pack for an HCS proof-wall demo called proof-wall: users browse a public message wall without a wallet, and posting requires connecting a wallet. No Solidity. Default seed. Emit the PRD, spec, static validator, and yarn validator.
evals.expected_output: A coherent Tier 0-1 pack under docs/prds/proof-wall.md, specs/proof-wall.yaml, validators/proof-wall-static.json, validators/proof-wall-yarn.json with matching names, commented higher tiers, and a yarn command named install.

assertions.name: names-install-command
assertions.description: Command validator has a command literally named install

assertions.name: recommends-hcs-skill
assertions.description: Recommends generator skill hedera-consensus-service for HCS

assertions.name: keeps-tiers-commented-or-minimal
assertions.description: Defaults to Tier 0-1 / keeps higher tiers commented

assertions.name: separates-authoring-from-generator
assertions.description: States that authoring skills must not be vendored into generator skills lists

evals.prompt: Deepen my existing proof-wall pack to Tier 3. Derive acceptance contract assertions from the PRD journeys (browse without wallet; wallet-gated post). Do not put C1/howToVerify into the PRD.
evals.expected_output: An acceptance contract with C1/C2/... assertions, evaluationRules fail-closed posture, and instructions to uncomment contract + validator in the spec — without mirroring assertion text into the PRD.

assertions.name: uses-assertion-ids
assertions.description: Contract uses numbered assertion ids starting at C1

assertions.name: oracle-integrity-reminder
assertions.description: Reminds that contract text must not go into the PRD

evals.prompt: When should I enable chainValidation for my harness pack, and what YAML fields do I need?
evals.expected_output: Guidance that Tier 3.5 is opt-in, requires Tier 3, network testnet, operator env vars, and executableWithTestSigner assertions.
